agenda.2026-11-12-cisco-resultats.title: Cisco reports first-quarter results
agenda.2026-11-12-cisco-resultats.why: The networking-equipment giant reports the quarter ended October 24 after Wall Street closes, with a call at 10:30 p.m. Paris time; it has guided for revenue of $18.0 to $18.2 billion [1][2]. Its comments on AI-related demand can move the whole tech sector, already shaken by the early-November crash.
